title: Liquid Components: Glassmorphism React Library on shadcn/ui
excerpt: Liquid Components is an open-source React component library that brings the trendy glassmorphism aesthetic to your projects. Built on shadcn/ui, it offers ready-to-use, accessible components that streamline UI development and add a modern, fluid look to web applications.
description: Liquid Components is an open-source glassmorphism React library built on shadcn/ui. It offers ready-to-use, accessible components for modern web interfaces.
